data.title: Commercial Account Executive
data.description:
A little about us

incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Netflix, Etsy, and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $96 million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

Commercial AE is where incident.io's growth gets made real - you're in front of the most ambitious digital-native companies out there, and the deals you close show up in the trajectory of the whole business.

What that looks like day to day

This is a full-cycle AE role with a strong outbound bias. Yes, inbound comes in - but the AEs who thrive here are the ones who don't wait for it. You'll own your own pipeline from the ground up, building target lists, running creative outreach campaigns, and picking up the phone without being asked twice. Outbound here is a craft, not a numbers game.

You'll be selling into VP Engineering, CTO, and SRE leaders at some of the most forward-thinking digital-native companies in the world. Deals typically land in the $40k–$50k range with a clear path into six figures, and a sales cycle of around 45 days means you're moving fast and closing regularly.

We run a pod model - you'll work closely with a BDR and Solutions Engineer rather than whoever happens to be free. That means real partnerships, shared context, and accountability that goes both ways. You'll also work alongside CS from early in the deal, which means handoffs that don't lose the thread.

What makes the selling here different is the product and the story behind it. incident.io is an AI-native platform built by engineers, for engineers - our founders have been on-call, they've felt the 2am page, and they built something to fix it. When you're in a room with a CTO or an SRE lead, you're not pitching software - you're talking to someone about a problem they've lived, and you understand it. That's the edge.

AEs here are AI-forward in how they operate - whether that's building business cases, running research, or finding smarter ways to work a territory. We expect you to bring ideas, not just execute a playbook.

The progression is real. Commercial AEs have moved into Enterprise and into management - and we'll be straight with you about what the path looks like and what it takes to get there.

Who you are

  • You've closed deals at a similar size and pace before - $40k–$50k ACV, sub-60-day cycles - and you've got the numbers to back it up.

  • Outbound doesn't feel like a chore to you. You see it as a craft - you build your own lists, think creatively about how to get in front of the right people, and don't rely on a sequence template to do the work for you.

  • You're genuinely curious about what it's like to be an on-call engineer. Not just the technical side - the stress, the 2am pages, the pressure of being the person whose job it is to fix things fast. That empathy shows up in how you sell.

  • You can hold a technical conversation without leaning on your SE every time. You'll have support when you need it, but you're comfortable going deep on your own.

  • You're scrappy in the best sense - you don't wait for resources, you figure it out. A bigger company with more tools, more inbound, and more hand-holding would actually frustrate you.

  • You pick up the phone. Cold calling doesn't make you wince, and a voicemail doesn't derail your afternoon.

  • Startup life genuinely appeals to you - not as a stepping stone, but because you want to be somewhere your work is visible and your impact is real.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

  • Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover, we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

  • Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

  • First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

  • Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

  • Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

  • Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

  • Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

  • Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

data.title: Lead Legal Counsel, IP
data.description:
Introduction to Role & Team

At Bumble, our mission is to create a world where healthy and equitable relationships and friendships thrive, and our Legal team plays an important role in protecting the ideas, brands, technology, and experiences that bring that mission to life. As Lead Legal Counsel within our IP team, you’ll be a senior subject-matter expert helping Bumble navigate complex intellectual property questions across our brands, products, technology, content, and creative work. You’ll independently lead significant IP matters and shape practical strategies in close partnership with colleagues across Legal, Marketing, Creative, Brand, Design, Product, and Engineering, combining Courage and Curiosity with strong commercial judgement. You’ll also help us explore the opportunities and risks created by AI and other emerging technologies, using AI thoughtfully in your own work while applying human judgement, care, and accountability to the outcomes.

What You’ll Do

  • Shape and execute Bumble’s global intellectual property strategy in partnership with Legal leadership, translating business, brand, product, and technology priorities into practical approaches to protection, portfolio management, licensing, and enforcement.

  • Take ownership of significant matters across Bumble’s international trademark, copyright, patent, domain name, trade secret, and broader digital asset portfolio, working with external counsel and specialist providers to protect strategically important intellectual property.

  • Collaborate with purpose across Marketing, Creative, Brand, Design, Product, and Engineering, providing practical rights-clearance and IP advice from early concept and development through launch, including trademarks, copyright, publicity rights, creator and talent rights, user-generated content, and third-party materials.

  • Independently lead complex IP enforcement and dispute matters, including infringement, oppositions, litigation support, and evidence management, applying commercial judgement to determine where action can deliver meaningful protection for Bumble’s brands and innovation.

  • Advise on the creation, ownership, protection, licensing, and commercialisation of Bumble-developed intellectual property, and draft and negotiate sophisticated IP arrangements including licences, coexistence agreements, assignments, merchandising arrangements, technology agreements, and strategic partnerships.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering on patent strategy, software development, open-source software, and innovation protection, while advising on emerging IP questions involving generative AI, training data, provenance, ownership, licensing, and infringement risk.

  • Take ownership of IP priorities from insight to impact by supporting due diligence for significant partnerships, investments, and acquisitions and by developing practical playbooks, precedents, training, and self-service guidance that help teams identify and manage IP risk consistently.

  • Champion Bumble’s values of Excellence and Respect by providing clear, pragmatic advice to senior stakeholders and maintaining an agile mindset as legal, technology, and business priorities evolve. Use approved AI tools where appropriate to strengthen legal research, review, summarisation, and knowledge management, while carefully assessing outputs for accuracy, privacy, bias, and responsible use.

 

About You

  • You are qualified as a solicitor in England and Wales, or hold an equivalent qualification in another European jurisdiction.

  • Typically requires 8+ years of experience, though we welcome candidates with alternative backgrounds that demonstrate equivalent skills.

  • You bring deep intellectual property expertise, particularly across trademarks, copyright, brand protection, licensing, portfolio management, rights clearance, and technology-related IP matters, developed in-house, in private practice, or through a combination of both.

  • You have strong experience advising consumer technology or similarly complex businesses on intellectual property issues involving software, digital content, product innovation, AI, and emerging technologies, and can independently develop practical solutions to significant or unusual legal questions.

  • You are an accomplished drafter and negotiator who can manage sophisticated IP and technology arrangements and translate complex legal concepts into clear recommendations that enable informed commercial decisions.

  • You collaborate with purpose and build trusted relationships with senior partners across different disciplines. You take ownership of challenging matters, see work through from insight to impact, and adapt your approach with an agile mindset as priorities and information evolve.

  • You combine sound commercial judgement with strong organisational and project-management skills, distinguishing material business risks from theoretical ones while effectively managing multiple priorities, international portfolios, external advisers, and specialist providers.

  • You demonstrate Curiosity, Courage, and Excellence in how you work, and you are comfortable identifying and using AI opportunities to improve effectiveness and insight while exercising appropriate human judgement and applying AI responsibly, inclusively, and with care for confidentiality and data privacy.

 

Benefits & Perks

  • Annual personal learning & development budget

  • Private Medical Insurance (PMI)

  • Private Dental Insurance

  • Babylon Health app

  • Mental health support

  • Enhanced parental leave, including a highly competitive maternity package

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Subsidised gym membership

  • ‘Double matched’ pension contributions up to 6%

  • Premium App Access

About Us

Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products.

AI Fluency

AI is important to us. We’re excited by people who are curious and experimental, and who think thoughtfully about how AI can amplify their impact and outcomes.

We encourage you to use AI responsibly as you prepare your application. Please don’t use it to fabricate experiences or answer questions live in interviews. We care deeply about authenticity and want to understand your real skills, judgment and voice, because building a meaningful, genuine connection with you matters to us.

Final Compensation

Will be determined based on factors such as the selected candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, skill set, and other job-related considerations.

Inclusion at Bumble Inc.

Bumble Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and we strongly encourage people of all ages, color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, parents, people with disabilities, and neurodivergent people to apply. We're happy to make any reasonable adjustments that will help you feel more confident throughout the process, please don't hesitate to let us know how we can help.

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example: she/her, he/him, they/them, etc).

AI in Bumble Inc. Hiring

At Bumble, we may use AI tools to support parts of our recruitment process — such as helping us record, transcribe, and summarize conversations, and supporting job alignment by comparing resumes and job descriptions to highlight skills and potential roles that may be a good match. These tools help us work more efficiently and stay focused on you during our conversations. Importantly, all hiring decisions are made by people. AI is used only to support our team’s efficiency and improve the candidate experience — not to evaluate or decide on your candidacy. Participation in AI-supported interviews and conversations is completely voluntary and will not impact your candidacy. If you’d prefer to opt out, simply let your recruiter or interviewer know at the start of a call, or anytime during the interview or conversation. Summaries and related data are retained only as long as needed in line with our internal data retention policies. If at any point you’d like a transcription or summary deleted, please contact your recruiter directly.

Fraudulent Candidate Detection

Our applicant tracking system analyzes signals relating to device, IP, email, and phone data associated with each application to protect applicants and our hiring process from fraudulent applications. These signals provide indicators for internal review only and do not constitute a definitive determination of identity or intent. No applicant is rejected, advanced, or otherwise affected based solely on this analysis without human review

For further information on how we hold and manage your data, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

data.title: Workplace Experience Manager
data.description:
Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work.

Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual.

Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate.

A bit about us:

🚀 We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on.

🏢 Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision.

💰 We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date.

🤝 We're trusted by 5,000+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster.

💡 Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one.

The Job, in a Nutshell

Orbital's London office isn't just a place to sit - it's where culture comes to life, where collaboration gets real, and where the best version of our company shows up every day. We need someone to own that.

As Workplace Experience Manager, you'll be the person who makes in-person time feel intentional, energising, and genuinely worth showing up for. You'll spot what needs improving before anyone else does, elevate what's already good into something exceptional, and care deeply about the details that most people never notice - but everyone feels.

This isn't a head-down admin role, and it's not a purely strategic one either. We want someone who can define what "great" looks like and then go make it happen - someone equally at home rethinking the summer party concept and making sure the snacks never run out.

You'll report into our Head of Operations and be based in our London office five days a week.

What You'll Do

Elevate the Workplace Experience

Our office should feel like the best version of Orbital - energising, considered, and somewhere people genuinely want to be. You'll own that. Not by waiting for someone to point out a problem, but by constantly asking what would make this better - and then making it happen.

You will:

  • Assess what’s working and what isn’t, and proactively improve it

  • Refine layout, flow, rituals, and small details that shift perception

  • Raise standards without being asked

You’ll play a central role in shaping our new London office and ensuring the space supports how we work.

Deliver events and rituals that matter

From Wednesday lunches to the summer party, from All Hands to company off-sites - every in-person moment is a chance to reinforce culture, build real connection, and make people feel good about where they work. You'll own the events calendar end-to-end and make sure every event is considered, well-executed, and genuinely worth people's time.

You will:

  • Develop clear concepts and briefs

  • Manage vendors and budgets confidently

  • Create simple communication plans to drive attendance and engagement

  • Design lightweight feedback loops, analyse results, and continuously improve

Run a flawless operation

Great workplace experience starts with a workplace that just works. Snacks stocked. Meeting rooms set up. Vendors sorted. You'll build the systems and habits that keep the fundamentals running so smoothly that nobody has to think about them - because you already have.

You will own:

  • The overall standards and day-to-day functioning of the office environment

  • Vendor relationships, facilities coordination, and office supplies

  • Organising weekly lunches and keeping snacks stocked

  • Health & safety essentials

  • AV and meeting room setup (calls work, screens connect, rooms are ready)

  • Desk booking software: managing the platform and ensuring it reflects real attendance patterns

  • Meeting room scheduling and utilisation: preventing friction and resolving booking issues

You’ll proactively monitor how the office operates, spotting and resolving issues before they surface.

Own the first impression

Whether it's a candidate walking in for their first interview or a new joiner arriving on day one, you're often the first face of Orbital people meet in person. That moment matters more than most people realise. You'll make sure it's warm, considered, and sets exactly the right tone.

Working closely with the People and Talent teams, you will:

  • Ensure interview days run smoothly, including preparing rooms and coordinating logistics

  • Be the welcoming face for candidates on interview days, stepping in as the on-site host when the Talent team aren't available

  • Send welcome emails to new joiners ahead of their start date and add them to the new starter programme calendar

  • Arrange travel for new joiners who are onboarding at another Orbital office

  • Meet new joiners on their first day and lead the office induction alongside IT

  • Act as the primary office point of contact throughout the onboarding period

  • Reinforce and strengthen our employer brand through every in-person interaction with candidates and new joiners

A brilliant office initiative that nobody knows about isn't brilliant. You'll make sure people are informed, excited, and showing up - by communicating clearly, consistently, and with real personality.

You will:

As part of the wider Back Office ecosystem, you’ll support operational processes where workplace and wider operations intersect.

  • Standardising the global office experience: Working alongside our US Office Lead to ensure that everyone at Orbital has a great office experience, regardless of where they are based.

  • High standards, discretion and strong attention to detail

  • Strong operational reliability: you create systems so basics don’t break

  • Proactive ownership: you don’t wait for detailed briefs

  • Background in hospitality or events

Why this might not be for you

  • You see operational work as beneath you. This role involves ordering supplies, sorting the kitchen, and dealing with day-to-day logistics. If you're after a purely strategic position, this isn't it.

  • You prefer steady rhythms or high predictability. There will be weeks where an event or a project requires extra effort. We don't expect it constantly, but flexibility matters.

  • You're not comfortable being in the office most days. This is an in-office role.

  • Large, established companies are more your speed. We're a growing Series B company. Things change, processes are still being built, and comfort with ambiguity is essential.

  • Details don't excite you. The gap between a good workplace and a great one lives in the small things. If you're not someone who cares whether each meeting has a room that works for their agenda or an event feels thoughtful, this won't bring out your best work.

🔒 Security is everyone’s responsibility at Orbital. We ask all team members to follow our security policies, complete regular awareness training, and handle sensitive data with care in line with ISO 27001 standards. Spot something unusual? Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on.

💡 At Orbital, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially welcome applications from people who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, or if the right role isn’t listed yet, we’d still love to hear from you.

💰 This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on several factors, which may include job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and business requirements.

Everyone who works with Orbital goes through background screening before they start. It's part of how we keep Orbital secure, for the people who work here and for the client information we're trusted with.

Special Projects

London (Shoreditch) | In person | Full time

About Seamflow

We're removing one of the last great barriers to progress in the physical world. While software moves fast, industries like healthcare, aerospace, and energy are still slowed by outdated, manual systems.

Our vision is to unlock enormous value for Testing, Inspection, and Certification companies globally. The market is vast, the problem is real, and we're just getting started.

We're rapidly growing following our 14x oversubscribed seed round backed by Tier 1 investors including Northzone and Initialized Capital. These funds backed the founders of Coinbase, Reddit, Klarna, and Spotify.

We're growing very fast; demand is outstripping our supply, and we're building fast to keep up.

The Team

Our team includes AI researchers from world-leading academic institutions like Johns Hopkins, MIPT, Oxford, Cambridge and UCL, former founding engineers at unicorn startups, and alumni of X, Google, Amazon, and Yandex, alongside former leaders from McKinsey, BCG and Bain. We look for people who move fast, think clearly, and hold themselves to a high bar. The standard here is very high, and we're looking for someone who raises it further.

The Role

Special Projects sits directly alongside the CEO and Chief of Staff and takes on whatever the company needs most at that moment. There is no fixed remit and there is no playbook.

One month that means preparing the material and the numbers behind a fundraise. The next it's working through legal, regulatory, and market access questions in a country we're entering, or holding an entire function open on your own until we've hired someone permanent into it. Whatever is broken, missing, or unowned lands here first.

Be clear eyed about what this is. It is demanding, and a lot of it is unglamorous. Some of it is detail work that simply has to be right, with nobody available to check it behind you. What we need is a workhorse who is obsessive about detail, who closes things out rather than hands them back, and whose work nobody ever has to second guess. If that reads as a description of you rather than a warning, this is the highest leverage seat in the company for someone early in their career. You will be in the room for decisions most people see five years later.

What We're Looking For

1–3 years in an environment with a high bar and short feedback loops: investment banking, strategy consulting, a fast growing startup, or something equally demanding we haven't thought of.

An exceptional track record: We care that you were at the top of whatever room you were in, academically and professionally.

AI-native: You already run your work through AI and operate at 10x as a result. You reach for these tools by default, not as a novelty, and you're constantly finding new ways to compress what used to take days into hours.

Structured thinking: You break messy, ambiguous problems into parts, work out what actually matters, and sequence it. You can explain your reasoning on a whiteboard in two minutes.

Ruthless organisation: Multiple workstreams, nothing dropped, nothing chased twice, everything written down.

Strong with Excel, slides, and written communication: Most of our work travels as documents and models read by executives at large regulated businesses.

Bias to action: You'd rather ship a good plan today than a perfect one next week.

Work nobody has to check: You close the loop, catch your own mistakes, and flag the things you couldn't resolve rather than leaving them to be discovered.

Low ego, high agency: The work ranges from a board memo to cleaning a customer data set at 9pm. Neither is beneath you, and you'll take on the boring half as readily as the interesting half.

Someone who wants to be in the room, not on a call. This role is in-person, full time at our Shoreditch office.

Nice to have: European languages, particularly German or French.

What You'll Get

A huge amount of responsibility and trust from day one, and direct exposure to every decision that shapes the company

A front row seat to enterprise sales, product, fundraising, and operations, and a real say in all of them

A clear path into an operating or commercial leadership role as we scale or insight into how to start your own tech company some day

A team that moves fast, works hard, and backs each other fully

Lunch and dinner covered, 24/7 gym access

Who we are:

We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech companies – on a mission to create the world's most empowering way to pay.

We launched the product in 2020 and achieved double unicorn status, valued at $2 billion, and since then have taken on more than 6 million customers.

 

Our mission is to become the best way to pay for anything, anywhere and say goodbye to credit costs for everyone. This is huge. Want to join us?

About the role.

The Senior Financial Accountant is responsible for key areas of Zilch’s month-end close, financial reporting and operational expenditure accounting. The role operates with a high degree of independence, ensuring financial information is accurate, complete and delivered in line with reporting deadlines and control requirements.

The role requires the individual to resolve complex accounting and operational issues, determine appropriate approaches to new or ambiguous assignments, and identify improvements to Finance processes, systems and controls. The Senior Financial Accountant works closely with colleagues across Finance and the wider business, contributes to cross-functional initiatives and supports the development of junior team members.

Day-to-day responsibilities.

  • Own relevant areas of the monthly management accounts across the P&L and balance sheet, ensuring accurate and timely reporting.

  • Take end-to-end responsibility for operational expenditure accounting and the accruals process, ensuring costs are complete, accurate and appropriately recognised.

  • Partner with FP&A on operational expenditure, explaining performance against budget, investigating variances and providing meaningful commentary and insight.

  • Own specified non-Opex accounting areas, including IFRS 16 lease accounting, advertising revenue and customer acquisition costs.

  • Work with Sales, Growth and other stakeholders to obtain the information required for accurate accounting and determine the appropriate accounting treatment.

  • Own the Finance relationship for Zilch’s Polish subsidiary, working with the local Finance team and external accountants to review the monthly trial balance and supporting reconciliations.

  • Resolve subsidiary accounting queries and oversee management and statutory reporting activities to support accurate and timely consolidation into Group reporting.

  • Prepare and review month-end journals, including accruals, prepayments and fixed assets, in accordance with reporting deadlines and financial controls.

  • Complete and review detailed balance sheet reconciliations, proactively investigating and resolving discrepancies.

  • Provide clear financial commentary, variance analysis and insight to Finance and non-Finance stakeholders.

  • Support the preparation of year-end accounts and completion of the external audit, independently resolving matters within the role’s areas of ownership and escalating more complex issues appropriately.

  • Provide guidance to the AP and AR function, supported by analysis of ageing, expenditure and other relevant trends.

  • Identify risks, control gaps and opportunities to improve Finance processes, systems and ways of working.

  • Define and implement practical improvements that increase the accuracy, efficiency and scalability of Finance operations.

  • Contribute to the continued development and optimisation of NetSuite, working with internal stakeholders and Oracle consultants to define requirements, assess options and support implementation.

  • Determine the appropriate approach for new or ambiguous assignments, presenting options and recommending practical solutions where established procedures do not fully address the issue.

  • Support medium to large Finance projects and cross-functional initiatives, taking ownership of defined workstreams of low to medium complexity.

  • Manage competing priorities and deliver accurate work against key reporting and project deadlines with minimal oversight.

  • Build effective relationships across Finance and the wider business, adapting communication and working styles to different stakeholders.

  • Simplify complex financial or technical information and communicate it clearly to Finance and non-Finance audiences.

  • Lead knowledge-sharing within relevant stakeholder groups and provide guidance and coaching to junior colleagues.

  • Ensure the role’s priorities and outputs remain aligned with Finance priorities, Zilch’s wider objectives and company performance.

What we're looking for...

Airspeed is AI revenue execution. We connect signals across CRM, calls, Slack, and product systems. Our agents flag deal risk early and help teams act. They coach reps, manage follow-ups, update the CRM, and identify likely slips.

Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile together with a short note sharing an example of an operational challenge or project you successfully managed. Tell us what the issue was, how you handled it, and the outcome.

data.title: Senior V&V Systems Engineer
data.description:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability
 
At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
 
By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.
 
We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

What you'll do

  • Own the system architecture and system model for Hypersonica’s high‑speed flight vehicles, ensuring mission intent, vehicle dynamics, avionics, and GNC form a coherent, verifiable whole. 

  • Lead aerospace systems architecture design, taking responsibility for how the vehicle is defined across disciplines from early concept through Preliminary Design Review (PDR) and beyond. 

  • Build and maintain the authoritative system requirements model, decomposing mission‑level objectives into clear, testable system and sub‑system requirements. 

  • Define and own the end‑to‑end system V‑model, including requirements validation, verification strategy, and clear readiness gates for Kick‑off and PDR. 

  • Apply model‑based systems engineering (MBSE) as a practical engineering tool, not a documentation exercise, ensuring traceability between requirements, models, analyses, and tests. 

  • Develop and deliver a 6‑DoF Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) model to PDR standard, in close collaboration with flight physics and avionics engineers. 

  • Apply closed‑loop control theory in the context of high‑speed flight and military guidance, ensuring controllability, stability, and performance are understood at the system level. 

  • Integrate vehicle dynamics, control laws, sensors, and actuators into a coherent closed‑loop system representation. 

  • Identify system‑level risks early particularly around requirements gaps, controllability, observability, and verification — and drive mitigations decisively. 

  • Act as a technical authority across disciplines, keeping architectural decisions coherent as designs evolve at pace. 


Who you are

  • An experienced Systems Engineer with a strong track record in system architecture, requirements decomposition, and delivery in safety‑ or mission‑critical environments. 

  • Deeply fluent in model‑based systems engineering, with practical experience owning requirements models and using MBSE to drive real engineering decisions. 

  • Strong grounding in closed‑loop control theory, applied to high‑speed flight, guidance, and defence or military systems. 

  • Comfortable developing and working with 6‑DoF flight and GNC models, and understanding their implications at vehicle level. 

  • Experienced taking systems through early design gates (Kick‑off, PDR), not just theoretical or paper studies. 

  • Someone who thinks in system behaviours, interfaces, and failure modes, not isolated components. 

  • Confident operating in ambiguous, fast‑moving environments where decisions must be made with incomplete data. 

  • Technically credible across disciplines, able to challenge assumptions and close decisions without consensus theatre. 

  • Motivated by working on systems where performance, robustness, and national‑level impact genuinely matter. 


Security and Elgibility Requirement
Due to the nature of the work with the UK MOD, applicants must be a British Citizen (or Dual UK national with British citizenship) and eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and, where required, Developed Vetting (DV) 

What we offer

  • A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security. 

  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow. 

  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes. 

  • A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions. 

  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly. 

  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy. 

At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply.
 
Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.
 
You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

data.description:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we're a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It's faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We're backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 6,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

The Role

This role reports to the VP of Product Marketing and owns product marketing for the Billing product group. You will work across Product, Growth, Revenue Marketing, Sales, Finance, Solutions, Customer Success, Support, and Brand to turn customer insight into a clear story, a strong go-to-market plan, and measurable market impact.

Monetisation becomes harder as software businesses grow. Pricing models, subscriptions, payments, invoicing, and revenue operations can become a patchwork that slows launches, creates risk, and pulls teams away from their customers.

You will turn a complex commercial problem into a clear story for the people who buy, build, operate, and grow software businesses. You will own the product-area narrative and execution, while partnering with cross-functional teams on broader company positioning, category strategy, and major commercial decisions.

What you'll do

  • Build customer and market insight through research, customer conversations, usage signals, competitive intelligence, and commercial feedback.

  • Define positioning, messaging, segmentation, proof points, and the product story for your product group.

  • Lead high-impact launches, commercial initiatives, and change programs from early strategy through readiness, channel activation, adoption, advocacy, and learning.

  • Build focused go-to-market plans across the channels that matter, with clear audiences, owners, trade-offs, and measures.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Finance, Sales, Solutions, Customer Success, and Support early enough to influence priorities, packaging, enablement, and customer outcomes.

  • Equip Revenue Marketing, Sales, Solutions, Customer Success, Support, and partners with clear stories, talk tracks, proof, and practical guidance.

  • Bring competitive and market insight into product, packaging, pricing, and go-to-market decisions, and identify opportunities to sharpen differentiation.

  • Set objectives and measures for customer adoption, retention, and commercial impact. Make practical recommendations using data and opportunity sizing to highlight the business and customer opportunity.

  • Use AI to improve research, synthesis, analysis, competitive intelligence, workflow automation, and product marketing quality, with strong judgement and verification.

We'd love to hear from you if you are

  • A track record of bringing complex B2B, fintech, payments, billing, infrastructure, or platform products to market.

  • Experience leading high-impact launches, migrations, packaging changes, or commercial initiative with measurable results.

  • Strong customer discovery, segmentation, positioning, storytelling, and commercial judgement.

  • The ability to connect product detail to outcomes such as growth, retention, efficiency, flexibility, and confidence.

  • Comfort working with technical, product, finance, operations, sales, solutions, support, and executive audiences.

  • Range across launches, enablement, adoption, change management, measurement, competitive insight, and customer advocacy.

  • Examples of using AI, agents, or automation to improve speed, quality, or insight.


What good looks like
Within your first year, the Billing team has a sharper product story, a repeatable approach to launches and commercial change, stronger enablement, and a clear view of what is driving customer adoption and business impact. Product and go-to-market partners trust you to bring clarity, make smart trade-offs, and turn insight into action.

Everyone is welcome at Paddle
At Paddle, we're committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer we don't care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you're from. 📍 London - Hybrid. 2 days per week in our London office, 3 days remote / work from home

We've spent the last three years transforming how our People Team operates. Now we're looking for someone to own the machine and work out what comes next!


About the role

We're looking for a People Operations Lead to own the operating layer of our People function, managing our People Operations Specialist and reporting directly to our People Director.

This is a slightly unusual brief, because we're looking for a very particular combination of experience.

First and foremost, you need to be an experienced, hands-on People Operations person. But you also need to have previously worked as an accountant, or have substantial professional accountancy experience.

And we mean accountancy specifically. Experience partnering with Finance, managing a People budget or processing payroll isn't the same thing.

Why such a specific combination? Because we've seen first-hand just how well it can work.

We've seen the value that a professional accountancy background can bring when combined with strong People Operations experience - financial discipline, an instinct for controls and data, and an analytical approach to understanding how systems and processes work. We're now deliberately looking for that combination again.

This isn't a traditional HR Operations role, and we're not looking for someone to simply keep existing processes running. We want someone who's genuinely curious about how and why things work - someone who spots friction, interrogates the data, challenges the way we've always done things and builds something better.

You'll inherit a strong foundation. Over the last three years we've streamlined manual processes, invested in our People technology and changed the way our People function operates. There's plenty we're proud of - but we're definitely not done!

You'll own our People operations, systems and data infrastructure across the end-to-end colleague lifecycle, making sure the fundamentals run brilliantly while continuously looking for opportunities to simplify, automate and improve them.

You'll also take significant ownership of our reward infrastructure, including quarterly pay reviews, salary benchmarking and banding, benefits and gender pay gap reporting. You'll work closely with our People Partners, Talent, Finance, Payroll and Tech teams, so this is a highly collaborative role with influence across Goodlord.

And increasingly, you'll help us answer a bigger question: what work should technology be doing for us?

We're already exploring how AI and agentic workflows can remove repetitive work across areas such as onboarding, colleague queries, document management, data validation and reporting. You don't need to arrive as an AI expert, but you do need to be excited about the possibilities, willing to experiment and comfortable helping us work out where technology can genuinely make things better.

If you get a kick out of taking something that already works, understanding it properly and making it simpler, smarter and better, we'd love to hear from you.

Who are you?

You're probably someone who sees People Operations a little differently.

You care about delivering a brilliant colleague experience, but you're just as interested in the systems, data and processes underneath it.

You don't accept a seven-step process because it's always had seven steps. You'll want to understand why it's there, whether we still need it and what would happen if we did it differently.

What does that mean in practice?

  • You're naturally curious and analytical. You ask good questions, get underneath problems and use data rather than instinct alone to make decisions.

  • You love improving how things work. You've reviewed, redesigned and implemented processes rather than simply inherited and administered them.

  • You're comfortable getting into the detail while still seeing the bigger picture - whether that's interrogating a spreadsheet, configuring a workflow or digging into an HRIS.

  • You're pragmatic, comfortable with ambiguity and a confident collaborator. You can turn an idea into something that actually works and bring people with you when something needs to change.

What we need from you

  • Previous professional experience working as an accountant or in a substantive accountancy role. This is essential for this particular hire.

  • Significant People Operations experience, with evidence that you've owned and designed end-to-end People processes, not simply operated processes someone else created.

  • Hands-on experience owning or significantly shaping People systems and data using a modern tech stack, including an HRIS (we use Personio, but we're of course open to others!) and/or headcount planning systems, alongside strong analytical and advanced Excel skills.

  • Experience across reward and benefits, ideally including ownership of pay review cycles, salary benchmarking and banding, benefits and gender pay gap reporting.

  • A track record of continuous improvement - spotting friction, getting underneath the root cause and leading meaningful changes that have made processes simpler, better or more scalable.

  • An active interest in AI and automation and how they can change the way People teams operate. You'll be comfortable experimenting with new tools and ways of working.

  • You'll be comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment and working across People Partnering, Talent, Finance, Payroll and Tech to solve problems and make change happen.

It would also be great if you have

  • Experience working in a high-growth, scale-up or similarly fast-moving environment.

  • Hands-on experience building or implementing AI/agentic workflows that are being used in practice.

And one thing you won't need

A particular HR qualification. We care much more about what you've actually built, improved and owned than whether you have CIPD after your name.

A little more about the contract

This is initially a three-month fixed-term contract. We're continuing to think about the longer-term shape of our People team, so there is the potential for the role to become permanent if there's a strong mutual fit and an ongoing need.

We're also open to part-time working for the right person. Finding the right combination of People Operations and professional accountancy experience matters more to us than insisting on a particular working pattern.

data.title: Head of Analytics
AIT MGSE Engineer - Lunar Lander
data.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.


As part of this initiative, we are developing a lunar lander capable of precision landing and reusable operations. To support this effort, we are establishing a dedicated remote test site in the United Arab Emirates to perform hot-fire propulsion testing and hopper flight demonstrations.

We want you as a talented AIT MGSE Engineer to help us in our mission by designing and delivering the MGSEs needed for the preparation and testing of our Lunar Lander.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as AIT MGSE Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day duties will include:

  • Work closely with Engineering and AIT colleagues to understand and refine the requirements/timelines for the different MGSEs that we will need for various assembly or testing activities.

  • Conceptualise, design (CAD including manufacturing drawings), procure and commission the MGSEs.

  • Confirm with mechanical analysis/hand calculations/proof tests that the design is compatible with the external loads.

  • Discuss with suppliers the MGSE designs for ease of manufacturing and with the most adequate processes.

  • Follow up the manufacturing/procurement with the suppliers (with the support of our supply chain team) and answer any technical questions/concerns ensuring timely delivery of all items.

  • Provide necessary instructions and support the assembly / commissioning / implementation of these MGSEs.

What we would love to see from you

In the role of AIT MGSE Engineer ideally, you will have the following:

  • Mechanical / Aerospace engineering degree or similar with focus on machine / structural design.

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in CAD design + drafting (using Siemens NX or similar) and FE analysis (using Hypermesh or similar).

  • Good understanding of machine design and different manufacturing processes (e.g. machining, welding, etc), design for manufacturing and GD&T.

  • Familiarity with standard margin calculation methodologies for various applications like beam design, bolted joints, welds, etc.

  • Experience with planning/execution of mechanical tests in-house would be a plus.

  • Good at documentation including design descriptions, assembly instructions, test reports, etc.

  • Creative with innovative ideas and technical problem solving/troubleshooting skills.

  • Basic hands-on experience with mechanical assembly and simple machining tools like drilling machine.

  • Previous experience in space AIT and MGSE design would be highly appreciated.

  • Good English communication skills (French would be a plus).

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

About the Role:

As a Sales Engineer, it’s your mission to show the value of Camunda and guide organizations planning to automate their core business processes.

You accompany prospective customers in their product evaluation of Camunda. You are responsible for achieving the product win, getting answers to all product related technical questions, and arranging all presales interactions driving the evaluation.

In this role you will partner with our Account Executives and Solution Architects, supporting you by conducting proof of concepts or handling other deeply technical discussions. You will help qualify opportunities and then help set and execute a sales strategy to achieve a win.

The effectiveness of Camunda's Sales Engineers is gauged by their ability to convert prospects into Camunda customers both efficiently and at a high rate.

This position requires a strong interest in cutting-edge software technologies. You should take pleasure in crafting sample code or custom demonstrations and exploring new technology, even if you're not highly experienced in software development. By empathizing with prospects, you better grasp their requirements and have engaging technical conversations, and excel at clarifying how Camunda's technology can benefit their business.

What you'll be doing:

In this role you will:

  • Map customer requirements to our Camunda product portfolio

  • Position potential quantitative and qualitative business value of Camunda

  • Develop individual Camunda evaluation plans and demos for our prospects

  • Conduct product demos and product related Q&A sessions

  • Support the completion of RFI / RFP documents

  • Team with Account Executives to develop accounts

  • Organize and execute pre-sales engagements

  • Implement code snippets

  • Create and maintain pre-sales content and technical artifacts

What you bring:

  1. Strong Technical Foundation:
     A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience. Solid understanding of programming fundamentals, modern software engineering practices, and common IT/system architectures.

  2. Proven Sales Engineering Experience:
     Experience in Sales Engineering or Pre-Sales, with a deep understanding of sales cycles, value-based selling, and stakeholder engagement. Skilled in handling objections and driving deals to closure in a consultative selling environment.

  3. Communication Excellence:
     Exceptional presentation and interpersonal skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives tailored to technical and non-technical audiences alike.

  4. Language Proficiency:
     Fluent in English (C1/C2 level or native proficiency)

  5. Travel Flexibility:
     Willingness to travel occasionally for customer meetings, events, and team collaboration.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience in enterprise automation, business process management (BPM), process orchestration, robotic process automation (RPA), Agentic-AI or similar domains.

  • Familiarity with value-based selling, including conducting value workshops and applying value engineering frameworks.

  • Strong understanding of the process automation and orchestration product landscape and key industry players.

  • Industry experience in BFSI, Telecommunications, or Logistics.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. About the Role:

As a Customer Success Manager at Camunda, you’ll be the strategic partner to a portfolio of enterprise customers, helping them turn complex process orchestration and automation goals into real, measurable outcomes. You’ll sit at the intersection of business impact and technical possibility—guiding customers through adoption, growth, and renewal while collaborating closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Consulting, and Support. In line with our FAITH values (Focus, Ambition, Integrity, Talent, Humor), you’ll combine clear thinking, honest partnership, and a bias for action to drive long-term success for our customers and for Camunda.

What you'll be doing:

  •  Own a portfolio of enterprise customers and act as their primary strategic partner from onboarding through renewal—aligning on goals, success measures, and an adoption roadmap that delivers real business value.

  • Drive retention and expansion by managing health, risk, and opportunities across your accounts, partnering with Sales and internal teams to secure renewals and uncover meaningful growth opportunities.

  • Lead structured customer conversations (e.g., onboarding sessions, success plan reviews, value and health check-ins) that connect Camunda capabilities to customer outcomes in clear, business-friendly terms.

  • Use data to tell the story—leveraging usage, value, and health signals to prioritize actions, forecast outcomes, and make informed recommendations for both customers and internal stakeholders.

  • Project manage cross-functional work (with TAMs, Consulting, Product, and Support) to unblock customers, close the loop on issues, and keep complex programs moving forward.

  • Contribute to our Customer Success practice by sharing learnings, mentoring peers, and helping refine playbooks, processes, and tooling as our team and portfolio scale.

What you bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

  • Relevant experience: 6+ years in Customer Success, Strategic Account Management, or customer-facing consulting in B2B software, ideally working with enterprise customers.

  • Relationship & stakeholder management: Proven ability to build trust with senior and operational stakeholders, navigate complex organizations, and lead candid, outcome-focused conversations.

  • Commercial awareness & forecasting: Experience supporting or owning renewals and expansion in a recurring revenue model, including comfort with forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and risk/opportunity assessment.

  • Data-informed decision-making: Ability to interpret customer data (adoption, health signals, value metrics) and turn it into clear insights, priorities, and next steps for both customers and internal teams.

  • Communication & facilitation: Strong written and verbal communication skills, including leading customer meetings, presenting recommendations, and aligning cross-functional collaborators in a remote-first environment.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience working with customers in financial services, banking, insurance, or other regulated industries.

  • Experience with orchestration, automation, or adjacent domains (e.g., process improvement, workflow, integration platforms) and/or technical products.

  • Hands-on familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, or similar CRM/CS platforms for managing accounts, activities, and health.

  • Experience working closely with technical counterparts (e.g., Solution Architects, TAMs, Engineering, or Product) to drive adoption and resolve complex issues.

  • A track record of mentoring peers, contributing to playbooks, or helping shape how a Customer Success team operates.

data.title: Technical Sourcer
data.description:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles.

The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance.

Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders.

Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work.

 

What you’ll do

As Technical Sourcer at Arago, you will own the search for some of the most sought-after engineers in the world. We build hardware that has never existed before, and finding the people who can build it requires going far beyond standard recruiting channels.

You will own the full sourcing motion: mapping talent pools, building precise searches, crafting outreach that resonates with passive candidates, and building long-term relationships with high-priority profiles. Working directly with hiring managers and founders, you will develop a deep understanding of each role and the technical landscape around it, then go find the right people, wherever they are.

Responsibilities

  • Build highly targeted searches for Arago's most critical roles, ASIC architects, packaging engineers, mixed-signal verification, SW systems leads

  • Craft outreach that engages passive candidates and builds long-term relationships with high-priority targets

  • Develop creative sourcing strategies: GitHub, research communities, referral networks, X-Ray etc.

  • Partner closely with hiring managers to build customized sourcing strategies

  • Own candidate tracking, pipeline metrics, and funnel data with a structured approach

  • Language: English at a proficient level.

We're Looking For

  • Proven sourcing experience in deep tech, semiconductors, or AI hardware, not just software

  • X-Ray search skills and comfort sourcing across GitHub, LinkedIn, and non-traditional channels

  • Demonstrated success sourcing passive senior technical talent

  • Ability to run multiple complex searches in parallel without dropping quality

  • Genuine curiosity about the technology, you need to understand what you're sourcing for

  • A long-game mindset: relationship building over transactional outreach

Nice to Have

  • Sourcing experience in technical domains

  • Proven track record of filling hard-to-find roles

  • Experience writing outreach that actually gets replies

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with multiple open roles simultaneously

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

  • Meaningful stock option plan offered (included in the majority of full time offers).

  • Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.

  • Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of AI at Arago.

About Gladia

Gladia builds the audio AI infrastructure behind the new generation of voice products. Our mission is to give every voice platform true conversational intelligence — the audio infrastructure that understands every conversation, turning voice into the world's most valuable data layer.

Our API turns real-world conversational audio into accurate, structured, real-time output — powered by our proprietary Solaria ASR, across 100+ languages, with industry-leading latency.

Hundreds of companies build their voice products on Gladia — from meeting assistants and voice agents to sales-enablement and contact-center platforms. We started in Paris, our growth is developer-led and heavily US-driven (and we're going after the US market hard).

Headquartered in vibrant tech hubs like Paris and New York City, Gladia has been by OVH Groupe — Europe's leading cloud provider — and now operates as a fully autonomous brand and company within the Group.

We're guided by four values:

  • Honest — Say the real thing, kindly.

  • Smart — Work smart, ship fast.

  • Builders — Own your scope, build to last.

  • Caring — Support people, take pride in the craft.

As a Senior AE, you'll uncover the challenges organisations ( voice agents, meeting assistants, contact-center platforms) face when they build and run Speech AI at scale and land the right Gladia solution for them. You'll sell a technical, usage or contract based API product to engineering and business stakeholders. Based in Paris. Reporting to Head of Sales.

The role

  • Run a rigorous, repeatable sales process across a range of company types and buyer profiles — from developer-led teams to enterprise buying committees.

Who you are

data.description:
À propos d'ILLUIN Technology

ILLUIN Technology est le leader français de l'IA Générative souveraine et de confiance. Nous développons des modèles de langage (LLM) propriétaires et une plateforme technologique de pointe pour permettre aux entreprises et aux organisations de déployer l'IA générative en toute sécurité, en gardant la maîtrise de leurs données.

Adossé au fond privé Seven2, Illuin est entré dans une phase d’investissement et de forte croissance depuis le début de l’année. Dans ce contexte d’accélération, le Groupe recrute un/une Chargé(e) d’Administration RH afin de sécuriser et de professionnaliser l’ensemble des processus administratifs liés au cycle de paie et à l’expérience interne des Illuiners.

Votre Mission

Rattaché(e) directement à la Direction Administratif et Financier, en lien étroit avec les équipes opérationnelles, vous êtes le/la garant(e) du contrôle interne de la paie et de la fiabilité des données sociales. La paie est externalisée auprès d’un prestataire : votre rôle n’est pas de la produire mais d’en assurer la préparation, le contrôle et la coordination de bout en bout.

Vous évoluerez dans un environnement dynamique et agile, dans un contexte de structuration où vous devrez faire preuve de rigueur, de polyvalence et être force de proposition afin de contribuer à l’avancement d’un vaste panel de missions tels que :

  • Pilotage et contrôle de la paie externalisée

    • Collecte, consolidation et transmission des éléments variables de paie au prestataire (entrées/sorties, absences, variables, primes, notes de frais impactant la paie) selon un calendrier de paie maîtrisé ;

    • Contrôle de la saisie des temps par les salariés (suivi des congés etc) ;

    • Collecte des déclarations sociales produites par le prestataire (DSN, charges sociales, organismes de prévoyance et de mutuelle) et suivi des éventuelles anomalies jusqu’à résolution ;

    • Rapprochement de la paie avec la comptabilité en lien avec le CFO et l’expert comptable (écritures de paie, provisions congés payés, comptes de tiers sociaux).

  • Administration du personnel et cycle de vie collaborateur

    • Gestion administrative des entrées : DPAE, rédaction des contrats et avenants, affiliations mutuelle et prévoyance, visites médicales, création des dossiers collaborateurs ;

    • Suivi des évolutions en cours de vie (avenants, mobilités, changements de temps de travail) et des sorties (documents de fin de contrat, coordination avec la paie et le management) ;

    • Suivi des absences, congés, arrêts de travail, IJSS et dossiers de prévoyance ;

    • Gestion des dispositifs collectifs et avantages (titres-restaurant, mutuelle, mobilité durable, remboursements transport) ;

    • Tenue et fiabilisation des obligations administratives : registre unique du personnel, affichages, archivage et conformité RGPD des données sociales.

  • Coordination des prestataires et interlocuteurs externes

    • Interlocuteur(trice) de référence du cabinet de paie : animation du rythme de collaboration, cadrage des livrables, respect des échéances et arbitrage des points bloquants ;

    • Point de contact avec les organismes externes (URSSAF, organismes de retraite et de prévoyance, médecine du travail, OPCO, mutuelle) en lien avec le prestataire et le CFO;

  • Data & Process Owner RH

    • Élaboration et documentation de l’ensemble des processus administratifs RH et de l’outillage associé (SIRH), dans un contexte de croissance et avec la perspective d’intégration de nouvelles entités ;

    • Garantie de la qualité et de la cohérence de la donnée sociale entre le SIRH, la paie et les outils Finance.

  • Conformité sociale et missions ponctuelles

    • Veille sur la réglementation sociale et l’application de la convention collective, avec appui de conseils externes sur les sujets complexes ;

    • Contribution aux obligations et échéances annuelles (index égalité professionnelle, déclarations obligatoires, préparation des audits) ;

    • Participation aux projets de structuration de la fonction People : déploiement ou évolution du SIRH, automatisation des processus, préparation des instances représentatives du personnel.

Profil Recherché

Il s’agit d’un poste évolutif, à la fois du fait de la croissance et de l’ambition du Groupe mais aussi de la variété des chantiers rencontrés laissant ainsi la place à l’expression des appétences de chacun.

  • Formation en Ressources Humaines, gestion de la paie ou droit social (Licence/Master, titre professionnel gestionnaire de paie)

  • Une expérience confirmée en administration du personnel et en gestion ou contrôle de la paie, en entreprise ou en cabinet

  • Bonne connaissance des mécanismes de paie et du cadre légal et conventionnel français ; une connaissance de la convention Syntec est un plus

  • Notions et curiosité appréciées sur les outils SIRH, l’automatisation des processus et l'A appliquée aux fonctions support

Nous recherchons un profil autonome et force de proposition faisant preuve d’une grande rigueur et d’un sens aigu de la confidentialité. Vous devrez faire preuve de curiosité, de polyvalence et d’une capacité d’adaptation pour évoluer sur plusieurs sujets de front demandant un regard critique, ainsi que d’un vrai sens du service auprès des collaborateurs.

Ce que propose le poste

  • Un rôle central et à forte visibilité, au contact de l’ensemble des collaborateurs et en lien direct avec la Direction,

  • Un périmètre complet, de la paie à l’administration du personnel,

  • La possibilité de construire son propre périmètre et sa fonction de zéro, en proposant les outils et les processus qui structureront la fonction People.

data.title: Account Executive Firm Expansion
data.description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

Afin d’accompagner notre croissance et répondre à nos enjeux 2026, nous ouvrons un nouveau poste au sein de l’équipe Sales en charge de la relation avec les clients SMEs des cabinets comptables partenaires de Pennylane.

Tu auras un rôle central en étant le point de contact privilégié des cabinets comptables souhaitant déployer Pennylane chez leurs clients

En effet, depuis 1 an, nous accélérons fortement dans l’acquisition de nouveaux cabinets comptables. L’outil Pennylane prenant tout son sens lorsque les Experts Comptables et leurs clients travaillent ensemble dessus, c’est dans leur intérêt d’équiper au maximum leurs clients.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

  • En échangeant avec les cabinets comptables partenaires pour identifier les SMEs de leurs portefeuilles les plus à même de pouvoir s’équiper de Pennylane.

  • En mettant en place des actions commerciales terrains (évènements physiques, webinaires, journée portes ouvertes) afin de faire connaître Pennylane auprès des SMEs de nos cabinets comptables partenaires.

  • En gérant de l’ensemble du cycle de vente de Pennylane sur ces SMEs (Qualification, Démo, Closing).

Tu travailleras main dans la main avec:

  • Les Account Executives Cabinets Comptables : ils sont en charge de vendre Pennylane à un maximum de cabinets comptables.

  • Les Account Managers : ils gèrent la relation commerciale avec le cabinet comptable et la coordination des projets de monétisation des SMEs avec nos cabinets comptables partenaires.

 

A quoi ressembleront tes débuts chez nous?

 

3 premiers mois :

  • Tu apprends à connaître Pennylane, sa vision, ses équipes afin de t'y sentir pleinement intégré

  • Tu intègres la sales academy afin de connaître parfaitement le rôle de chacun et de saisir le fonctionnement de l'équipe sales au global

  • Tu es formé par ton manager afin de prendre tes marques au sein de l'équipe

  • Tu montes en compétences sur l’outil

  • Tu prends en main tes prospects, accompagné par ton manger

  • Tu deviens autonome sur des ventes simples

4 à 8 mois

  • Tu gères en autonomie tes premières ventes complexes

  • Tu traites des leads de plus en plus complexes et stratégiques pour l'entreprise

  • Tu participes aux améliorations des process au sein de l'équipe et partage tes bonnes pratiques

  • Tu collabores avec les autres équipes de Pennylane (customer care, produit, sales...) afin de transmettre tes retours clients et participer à l'amélioration continue de notre plateforme

Et ensuite... :

  • Tu deviens un(e) AE confirmé (et donc un expert du produit), et tu es capable de gérer n'importe quel type de lead

  • Tu es owner d'un ou de plusieurs side project.s

  • Tu contribues activement à la mise à jour des process dans notre base interne (Notion)
